-118.41190,34.06010.name: LA IVF Clinic
-118.41190,34.06010.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Aykut Bayrak, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-99.19156,19.43419.name: Clinica de Reproducción
-99.19156,19.43419.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. OpenStreetMap holds what somebody chose to map, so a country with few points here may be thinly mapped rather than thinly served. That is the reverse of the national registers alongside it, which are close to complete for one country and silent everywhere else. This layer is a cross-check and a source of leads, not a count.

-82.45831,27.94499.name: Moffitt Research Institute
-82.45831,27.94499.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of H. Lee Moffitt Cancer Center. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

Rats, mice and birds bred for research are excluded from the Act's definition of an animal — the overwhelming majority of animals used, and the great majority of the genetically altered ones. What is covered here is dogs, cats, primates, rabbits, guinea pigs, hamsters and farm animals. The rest is counted nowhere.

6.98330,51.03330.name: Bayer — investor filings
6.98330,51.03330.desc: What a company tells its shareholders is a different document from what it tells a regulator, and both are public. The filings carry segment revenue, litigation provisions, R&D spend and the risk factors the board is legally obliged to disclose — including, in Bayer’s case, the running cost of the glyphosate claims. For anyone trying to establish what this business actually earns and fears, it is the most reliable source there is, because getting it wrong is a securities offence.

6.98330,51.03330.name: Bayer — Crop Science product safety summaries
6.98330,51.03330.desc: The company's own safety summaries for its products. Self-published safety documentation is the industry's account of itself, and comparing it against independent studies is only possible because it exists in a fixed form.

-0.13300,51.52500.name: Wellcome Trust
-0.13300,51.52500.desc: One of the largest charitable research funders in the world, with an endowment in the tens of billions, funding a substantial share of UK and global genomics. It is research money that does not need an exit, does not need a product, and can fund a twenty-year question. Very little of the work on this map is funded that way.

-46.68200,-23.58680.name: Huntington Medicina Reprodutiva
-46.68200,-23.58680.state: São Paulo — Av. República do Líbano 529
-46.68200,-23.58680.desc: The largest fertility group in Brazil, with clinics in São Paulo, Brasília and Campinas. It appears four times in the Latin American registry under slightly different names, which is what a chain looks like in a register that lists sites rather than owners.

-122.40700,37.65400.name: Emerald Cloud Lab
-122.40700,37.65400.desc: Runs biological experiments by remote instruction: a customer writes a protocol, robots execute it, and nobody involved needs a laboratory or the skill to use one. Institutional biosafety oversight attaches to a person at a bench, and there is no person at the bench.

-74.45000,4.85000.name: AGROSAVIA
-74.45000,4.85000.state: Mosquera, Cundinamarca — Colombian agricultural research corporation
-74.45000,4.85000.desc: Colombia's national agricultural research corporation, successor to the institute that built the country's national germplasm bank in the 1960s under a Rockefeller Foundation collaboration. It breeds and releases cultivars under its own name across crops and forages, runs the trial network they are tested in, and works jointly with Argentina's federal institute on the maize and soybean system. Its presence completes a pattern this map has now recorded four times over: in Argentina, Brazil, Nigeria and Colombia the plots where varieties are tested belong to state or international institutes, while in Europe and North America the same work is bought from private contractors. Which of those a country has determines whether trial data is a public record or a commercial confidence.
